name: Zhengzhong Tu

name: Haozhi Qi
title: Incoming Assistant Professor, starting January 2027; currently Member of Technical Staff at Amazon FAR
fitReason: A particularly direct physical-intelligence match: human demonstrations guide dexterous learning, while ForceBand transfers human muscle-signal-derived force supervision into robot manipulation policies.

physicalEvidence.summary: ForceBand (2026) evaluates a learned motion/force policy on a UR-5, Robotiq gripper, ZED 2i camera and fingertip force sensors, using 15 human demonstrations per object and ten trials on each of nine objects. REGRIND separately transfers residual RL policies to LEAP and WUJI robot hands.

name: Preston Culbertson
title: Assistant Professor
fitReason: Praxis Lab studies reliable learning under imperfect sensing and dynamics. REGRIND provides a current, tightly matched dexterous reinforcement-learning project rather than only optimization theory.

physicalEvidence.summary: The July 2026 REGRIND study runs learned residual policies on LEAP and WUJI hands with arm support and motion capture. Ten trials per configuration show successful scissors/screwdriver transfer on three hand/task pairings; WUJI-scissors fails all ten trials.

shortVisit.summary: The personal join section explicitly addresses Cornell undergraduates/master’s students and PhD applicants. It does not offer a current external-master’s internship or short visit. Cornell’s undergraduate summer program precedent is not evidence of external graduate eligibility.

scoreReasons.fit: Direct robust dexterous learning and tool-use match.
scoreReasons.physical: Current primary hardware study with explicit trial counts and limitations.
scoreReasons.shortVisit: Verified recruiting text is restricted to degree applicants or current Cornell students; no external visit route established.
